{{Quote|Jabba the Hutt has been told by Belshu, the smuggler now working for him, that there is a valuable Rantok Sword being held in a warehouse here on Tatooine. Jabba wants this sword to display on his wall.|[[G-5PO]]|<ref name="SWG:G5PO" />}}
A '''warehouse''' was in existence on the planet [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It housed a [[Rantok]] [[Sword/Legends|sword]] that [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]] wanted to hang on the wall of his [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|palace]].<ref name="SWG:G5PO" />
